sentences.en: I'll sell a kidney to the one who finds it.
sentences.zh: 为了钱，我愿意卖一个肾。

sentences.en: "She saved my life." "How?" "She gave me a kidney."
sentences.zh: "她救了我的命。" "怎么救的？" "她给了我一个肾"

sentences.en: "Do frogs have kidneys?" "No, but they do have hearts."
sentences.zh: "青蛙有肾脏吗？" "没有，但它们有心脏。"

senses.zh: 肾，肾脏,（可食用的动物的）腰子,脾气，性格
